\section{Math}

The mass and the energy relate as $E = mc^2$. The roots of
$ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ are
\[
  x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}.
\]

  f(x) &= \int_0^x e^{-t^2}\,dt, \\
  \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} &= \frac{\pi^2}{6}.
\end{align}
